description: Source code implementing a templating engine with functions for building, destroying, and applying templates, including internal data structures, error handling, and parsing logic.

classes.name: mustach_template
classes.description: Represents a compiled template with associated metadata and code blocks.

classes.name: block
classes.description: Represents a block of encoded template code.

classes.name: ex
classes.description: Extraction context for parsing template source text.

classes.name: pref
classes.description: Structure for managing prefix strings during rendering.

classes.name: mustach_apply_itf_t
classes.description: Interface for application callbacks during template rendering.

classes.name: mustach_build_itf_t
classes.description: Interface for building templates from source text.

methods.name: mustach_build_template
methods.description: Builds a template from source buffer and metadata.

methods.name: mustach_make_template
methods.description: Creates a template from source buffer and name.

methods.name: mustach_destroy_template
methods.description: Destroys a template and frees associated resources.

methods.name: mustach_set_template_data
methods.description: Sets user data at a specified index in a template.

methods.name: mustach_get_template_data
methods.description: Retrieves user data at a specified index from a template.

methods.name: mustach_get_template_data_count
methods.description: Returns the number of data slots in a template.

methods.name: mustach_get_template_name
methods.description: Returns the name of a template and its length.
